verdict.rationale: Foreloop's own agent reads a user feedback submission, fills in an intention and proposes tasks. It also produces automatic product reviews on pull requests with a score and actionable P0/P1/P2 findings. Both are in-product suggestions derived from the user's feedback and code. The evidence does not show broader insight generation such as trend analysis or summarization across submissions, and it does not explicitly say the PR review findings are AI-generated. Missing for 10: aggregate insights or trend summaries across a user's data, explicit confirmation that PR review findings are AI-generated, and independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
